bundle.shortDescription: VANZY configuration workspace with guarded Windows keymap access
bundle.longDescription: Unofficial experimental Windows keymap manager for already-paired VANZY A2 devices running firmware 3.2.1. Includes guarded updates, backups and explicit host-side input conversion. Other firmware is unsupported.
